name: Mango Season
effect: The whole coast smells like a smoothie. CHOOSE: gorge now — take 1 free South specialty — OR let it ride — add 2 extra South specialty tokens to the South Market (a glut you both race for).
art_note: Crates of golden mangoes piled at a roadside stand

name: Bubble-Tea Festival
effect: They're handing out pearls like confetti. CHOOSE: take 2 Buzz (the town's buzzing) OR take 1 free Central specialty (a fistful of pearls).
art_note: A street lined with bubble-tea stalls and paper lanterns

name: The Aunty Insists
effect: You said you were full three plates ago. She has already reached for the ladle. The drawer takes 2 free ingredients from their current region's Market (seconds — you do not get a vote).
art_note: A smiling auntie pressing an extra ladle of food into your bowl

name: The 4 a.m. Convenience Store
effect: You weren't hungry. You bought a 茶葉蛋 anyway. The drawer takes 1 free ingredient (current specialty OR pantry) + 1 Buzz.
art_note: A glowing 24-hour convenience store on an empty night street

name: The Stinky-Tofu Dare
effect: Smells wild, tastes incredible — the locals are right. The drawer MAY take the dare: reveal the top tile of their current region's supply. Specialty → take it FREE + 1 Buzz. Event → resolve THAT event now too (you asked for it). DECLINE → play it safe, take 1 Buzz.
art_note: A sizzling griddle of golden stinky tofu with pickled cabbage

name: The 3:47 to Zuoying
effect: 便當 in one hand, dossier in the other — doors closing. The drawer may immediately move 1 region for free (HSR counts North↔South adjacent).
art_note: A high-speed rail train blurring past a platform at Zuoying 左營

name: The Queue That Ate the Block
effect: Forty people deep and growing; nobody's sure what it's for, everybody needs it. The cheapest face-up Tier-1 vendor gains +1 Prestige — a race: whoever courts it first cashes the hype.
art_note: A sudden forty-deep queue snaking around a pop-up stall

name: The Food Blogger's Big Break
effect: Someone's reel just hit a million views and the whole town is mildly performing for the camera. Every agent's NEXT Promote gives +1 Buzz.
art_note: A food blogger filming a steaming bowl ringed by curious onlookers

name: Typhoon Day
effect: School's cancelled, offices shut, the whole island orders 泡麵 and 鹹酥雞 and doom-scrolls 美食 pics. Wash out and refill the coastal (South AND East) Markets' face-up specialties (a reroute — you lose nothing you hold). Then every agent EXCEPT the current Prestige (VP-track) leader takes 2 Buzz. Tied for the lead → everyone benefits.
art_note: A cosy lit window looking out on a grey storm

name: Plum Rains
effect: Grey drizzle, damp everything, a scooter seat you'll regret. The drawer's Stock Up this turn yields 1 fewer (a slow, soggy snack day — a tempo tax).
art_note: Grey drizzle over a quiet inland market street

name: Sold Out
effect: '完售' — the most heartbreaking word in the language; the last plate went to the person in front of you. Discard 1 face-up specialty from the current region's Market and refill it (the shelf resets — you lose nothing you hold).
art_note: A hand-lettered 完售 SOLD OUT sign hung across a shuttered stall

name: Scooter Gridlock
effect: Ten thousand scooters at one red light, all revving — beautiful, deafening, and you are not going anywhere fast. The drawer's next Travel arrives with no ingredient (the gridlock ate your time — a tempo tax, not a lost turn).
art_note: A wall of scooters packed at a red light

name: Fully Booked
effect: '客滿' hung across the door — could be a disaster, could be exactly the table you needed. Clear and refill an entire Market row (can help or hurt — roll with it).
art_note: A -客滿 FULLY BOOKED- sign across a bustling restaurant doorway
